decisions.scenario: Finding and booking a four-star place to stay in Cambridge

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Can you find me an expensive place to stay in the east?

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: The only hotel that matches those criteria is Express by Holiday Inn Cambridge. Would you like help with a booking?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Does that hotel have a four-star rating?

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: It has two stars. Would you like me to look for another option?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: I would really like a four-star place. Is there one in the moderate price range instead?

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: There are three options: A and B Guest House, Carolina Bed and Breakfast, and Warkworth House. Do you have a preference?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Carolina Bed and Breakfast sounds nice. Could you book it for six people for four nights starting on Monday?

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Your booking at Carolina Bed and Breakfast is confirmed for six people, starting Monday for four nights. Your reference number is RTNZCSBJ. Is there anything else I can help you with?

decisions.scenario: Planning a train to Kings Lynn and finding an architectural attraction

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: I need a train leaving Cambridge on Tuesday.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: There are several trains that may suit your needs. Do you have a destination in mind?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: I would like to go to Kings Lynn and arrive by 11:00.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Train TR7548 departs at 10:11 and arrives at 10:58. Would that work for you?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Yes, that works. I am also looking for an architectural attraction in the town centre.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Holy Trinity Church on Market Street is an architectural attraction in the town centre. Does that sound suitable?

decisions.scenario: Getting the address and postcode of a town-centre nightclub

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Hello. Are there any fun places to go in the centre of town?

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Ballare nightclub is in the centre of town. Would you like more information about it or another suggestion?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Can you give me the address and postcode for that nightclub?

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Of course. The address is Heidelberg Gardens, Lion Yard, and the postcode is CB2 3NA. Is there anything else I can help you with?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: I am all set, thank you.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Excellent. Have a great day!
